sources.snippet: SkinTokens is a learned, compact, and discrete representation for skinning weights. Built on this representation, TokenRig is a unified autoregressive framework that models the entire rig, i.e., skeleton and skinning weights, as a single token sequence. Given an input 3D mesh, it generates a complete skeleton hierarchy and skin weights that can be directly imported into standard 3D pipelines ...
